sources.title: sapinsapin/whisper-small-pld-fil · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: whisper-small-pld-fil openai/whisper-small finetuned on sapinsapin/pld. Trained for 2000 steps on 10000 clips (batch 8×2, lr 1e-05, fp16 + gradient checkpointing). WER/CER are on the held-out split, lowercased; CER is the model-selection metric (Taglish orthography varies at the word level).
